item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 7 #NLPRSD
item.description:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 7 #NLPRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at 05:00 PM 29 August 2026

Orange Warning: #Pangasinan
Associated Hazard: FLOODING and LANDSLIDE is THREATENING in flood-prone and landslide-prone areas

Yellow Warning: #Benguet
Associated Hazard: POSSIBLE FLOODING and LANDSLIDE in flood-prone and landslide-prone areas

Meanwhile, Light to Moderate to at times Heavy rains are expected over #Ifugao(Mayoyao, AlfonsoLista, Aguinaldo), #MountainProvince(Barlig, Natonin, Paracelis), #IlocosSur(Bantay, Cabugao, Caoayan, Magsingal, Nagbukel, Narvacan, SanIldefonso, SanJuan, SanVicente, Santa, SantaCatalina, SantoDomingo, CityOfVigan, Sinait), #IlocosNorte(Pagudpud, Burgos, Pasuquin, Bacarra, LaoagCity, SanNicolas, Sarrat, CityOfBatac, Paoay, Currimao, Pinili, Badoc, Marcos, Banna, Dingras, Solsona, Piddig), #Isabela(IlaganCity, SanMariano, Maconacon, SanPablo, Cabagan, Tumauini, Naguilian, CityOfCauayan, BenitoSoliven, Luna, ReinaMercedes, Cabatuan, Aurora, SanManuel, Burgos, Gamu, Quirino, Roxas, Mallig, Quezon, DelfinAlbano, SantoTomas, SantaMaria), #Cagayan(SanchezMira, Claveria, SantaPraxedes, Camalaniugan, Allacapan, SantoNiño, Amulung, Baggao, Alcala, Gattaran, Lasam, LalLo, Buguey, SantaTeresita, Gonzaga, SantaAna, Calayan), #Apayao(Pudtol and Flora) within the next 2 to 3 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #LaUnion, #NuevaVizcaya, #Quirino, #Aurora, #Ifugao(Banaue, Hungduan, Kiangan, Lagawe, Lamut, Hingyon, Tinoc, Asipulo), #MountainProvince(Bauko, Besao, Bontoc, Sabangan, Sadanga, Sagada, Tadian), #IlocosSur(Alilem, Banayoyo, Burgos, CityOfCandon, Cervantes, Galimuyod, GregorioDelPilar, Lidlidda, Quirino, Salcedo, SanEmilio, SanEsteban, SantaCruz, SantaLucia, SantaMaria, Santiago, Sigay, Sugpon, Suyo, Tagudin), #Abra, #Apayao(Conner, Kabugao, Calanasan, Luna, SantaMarcela), #IlocosNorte(NuevaEra, Adams, Dumalneg, Bangui, Vintar, Carasi), #Kalinga, #Cagayan(Tuao, Piat, Rizal, TuguegaraoCity, Peñablanca, Solana, Iguig, Enrile, Aparri, Ballesteros, Abulug, Pamplona), #Isabela(SanAgustin, Jones, Echague, Cordon, CityOfSantiago, Ramon, SanMateo, SanIsidro, Angadanan, Alicia, SanGuillermo, Palanan, Dinapigue and Divilacan) which may persist within 2 to 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 08:00 PM Today.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards. Residents along mountain slope are advised for possible landslides mudslides, rockslides and flash flood.

Keep monitoring for updates.
